_doc: Layer inventory for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 stubs all planned layers as not-yet-implemented entries so the engine can boot and the [data-ga-layer] chips have a registry to look up. Each layer's `tier` / `source` / `path_under_root` is the COMMITTED contract per SCHEMA section 28; the actual files don't exist yet (ship from the cluster-side genome-annotation pipeline, phase B+). Layers carrying `_optional: true` are facultative: when absent, the consuming page hides the corresponding panel rather than erroring.

_tier_legend.hot: RAM-pinned at trigger event; pages read state directly; <1ms
_tier_legend.warm: IndexedDB-cached at trigger event; first read async ~50ms; subsequent ~10ms

_round1_status: Thirteen layers (post-2026-05-19 meiosis carve-out) are CONTRACT-ONLY (not-yet-loaded). page_scaffold's scaffold renders them as 'not loaded' chips. Layer roster: assembly_stats, chromosome_map, centromere_telomere, gene_track, repeat_track, te_hierarchy, variant_annotations, conserved_elements, synteny_blocks, macrosynteny_orthologs, synteny_oxford_grid, ortholog_tables, ortholog_pairs.
_migration_note_2026_05_19: crossover_track, prdm9_motif, and nco_gc_track moved to meiosis-atlas on 2026-05-19. page_chromosome_overview consumes crossover_track cross-atlas from meiosis-atlas.
_migration_note_2026_05_23: Converted all bare `path:` entries to `root: <name>` + `path_under_root: <template>`. Roots resolve through master_config.yaml: genome_assembly, genome_annotation, genome_synteny, genome_conservation. Decouples disk layout from atlas code.

assembly_stats._feeds: page_assembly_stats QC banner + per-chrom table · OUT adapter for inversion atlas (genome.assembly_stats)

centromere_telomere._feeds: centromere bands · T2T completeness chip (phase B)

gene_track._feeds: gene cargo per inversion · functional context (phase B/C)

repeat_track._feeds: TE landscape · breakpoint repeat enrichment (phase B)

te_hierarchy._feeds: page_repeats_te View 4 — TE-hierarchy alluvial (per parental haplotype, N-level)
te_hierarchy._source_pipeline: RepeatMasker / EDTA post-processing — aggregate bp per (haplotype, repeat, te_category, class, order, family) tree per Wicker et al. 2007
te_hierarchy._schema: { haplotypes: [ { id, name, label, column_headers?, nodes: [<node>] } ] }; <node> = { id, name, pct, palette?, children?: [<node>] }.

synteny_blocks._feeds: collinearity vs related Siluriformes · ancestral karyotype (phase D)

macrosynteny_orthologs._feeds: page_synteny View 3 — MacrosyntR-style Oxford macro-synteny grid
macrosynteny_orthologs._schema: { pairs: [{ id, name, x: { id, name, chroms: [{ id, name, length_bp }] }, y: {...}, orthologs: [{ xc, xp, yc, yp }] }] }; positions in bp

synteny_oxford_grid._path_doc: Per ordered focal pair (genome A x genome B). Renderer fetches the file matching the active selection from the page_synteny toggle; never enumerates the directory.
synteny_oxford_grid._source_pipeline: OrthoFinder -> macrosyntR (SamiLhll/macrosyntR) chrom-pair Fisher exact + BH

ortholog_tables._path_doc: One file per focal genome. Renderer interpolates focal_id from shared.focalGenome.
ortholog_tables._feeds: page_orthologues Views 1 + 2 — focal x non-focal summary table and per focal-chrom %1:1 breakdown

ortholog_pairs._path_doc: Per (focal, non-focal) pair. Lazy-loaded on column reveal in page_orthologues View 3.

layers._meiosis_layers_moved: crossover_track, prdm9_motif, nco_gc_track moved to meiosis-atlas 2026-05-19.

te_abundance._source_pipeline: EDTA + RepeatMasker per species (Chapter 5 module step 04)

kimura_landscape._source_pipeline: RepeatMasker divsum per species (Chapter 5 module step 02)

centromeres_cgar._source_pipeline: quarTeT / centromics on Cgar RefSeq (Chapter 5 module step 04)

breakpoint_te_cross._feeds: page_comparative_te V5 · Inversion Atlas page16 (breakpoint badge)
